name: Oguni (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Oguni town emblem in white: a disc with a green stylised mountain of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Oguni, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 June 1980.

features.role: Oguni town emblem — a disc with a green stylised mountain of curved strokes
